applicant_utility.summary: PRSRS is a small, sport-focused research scholarship jointly funded by the Oceania National Olympic Committee and USP, and only three awards were made for 2026, so the field is narrow but the package is strong. You need a research Master's idea that sits in the economics, social impact or physical education of sport, a GPA of 3 or above, and citizenship of a USP member country; a postgraduate diploma helps but is not required. Two features distinguish it from PSERI: the age preference is relaxed to 40 rather than 35, and the award builds in an industry placement for one semester alongside a semester of teaching, so this is a scholarship for someone who wants their research connected to the sports sector rather than purely academic. As with the other USP Research Office awards, the scholarship pays nothing towards getting you into an academic unit - you must enrol separately.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Citizens of a USP member country aged 40 or under with a GPA of 3 or above who want a funded research Master's at USP on the economics, social impact or physical education of sport and are happy to do an industry placement.
application_readiness_checklist: Shape your research outline around sport specifically, within economics, social impact or physical education - a generic topic in those fields will not read as a sports project
Request certified true copies of your transcripts and certificates well in advance, since certified copies cannot be produced overnight
Identify a USP academic unit and, where possible, a potential supervisor you can discuss the application with before submitting
Name three referees and confirm their contact details are current
Assemble the Applicant Detail Form, the applicant checklist and the research intent outline into one clean package
Email everything in a single message with the exact subject line format rather than sending documents separately
common_rejection_risks: Proposing research in economics, social impact or physical education without a genuine sports focus, which is the whole point of the funders
Missing the 3.0 GPA threshold - it is lower than PSERI's 3.5 but it is still a hard floor
Assuming a postgraduate diploma is mandatory and not applying, when the page says it is preferred but not mandatory
Assuming the award guarantees enrolment in an academic unit when it explicitly does not
Being over 40, since the page states a preference for applicants 40 or younger
Being unwilling to complete the industry placement semester, whose terms are only settled on confirmation of award
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition, General Services fees, Health Services fees, the living allowance and the book allowance are covered, and one return airfare is provided when you must travel to a USP campus in another country. The research grant is conditional on AURC approval of both the research plan and the budget, so fieldwork costs may sit with you until that approval is granted. The dependants allowance is limited to primary dependants residing with you during the scholarship, and the establishment allowance requires relocating to a USP campus, so applicants already living near campus or with dependants living elsewhere will not receive those components.
document_audit: Transcripts and certificates must be certified true copies; ordinary scans of your own printouts will not meet the requirement
All eight documents must travel in the same email, with the subject line following the prescribed format including your own name

If you claim a dependants allowance, you must supply proof of marriage and the spouse's employment status, and for children evidence the relationship, residence with you, age under 18 and your main and continuing support

If you claim the establishment allowance, you must show you are relocating from outside the greater Suva area, that neither you nor your partner receives a relocation package from another organisation, and that the award will last at least 12 months
Proof of citizenship is mandatory, so check your passport or citizenship document is current
alerts: The 2026 round closed at midnight on 5 January 2026 and the page is marked CLOSED; only three awards were made, so competition is tight and the window is short
Enrolment in the academic unit is separate from the scholarship and is not guaranteed by it
The industry placement semester is a condition of the award, with terms only agreed on confirmation, so ask about it before you accept
No paid employment is permitted for the whole tenure, so plan to live on the FJD 21,600 living allowance
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Assemble all eight documents, email them as one package to the USP Research Office postgraduate scholarships mailbox with the prescribed subject line, then follow up by email or with the Research Student Coordinator; enrolment in the academic unit is arranged separately once awarded.
